mapper.select: select count(*) from material_observation mo join paper p on p.paper_id = mo.paper_id and p.deleted = false where 1 = 1

select mo.paper_id, mo.material_key, mo.type, mo.content, mo.confidence,
ts_rank(mo.content_fts, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{tsQuery})) as score
1.0 as score
from material_observation mo join paper p on p.paper_id = mo.paper_id and p.deleted = false where 1 = 1
order by
score desc,
mo.confidence desc nulls last, mo.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
